The tail 'and lands <identifiers>' is a landing attribution, and the subject's own sibling objects prove the lineage treats those as fixed: in the same appliesFindingsOf map, every landed field pins its site historically ('ACCEPTED at g21 leftover-join.v6', 'Landed at g21 leftover-join.v7', 'Landed in this lineage at g21 leftover-join.v9', 'Landed in this lineage at g21 leftover-join.v11') and only the separate 'carries that measurement / carries that recital' clauses roll to g21 leftover-join.v22.
